run.note: Noun (a run) and verb (run a playbook = 플레이북 실행) are both 실행 in existing strings; disambiguate with particles (이 실행, 실행을 시작하다) when needed.

resume a run.note: No existing translation; verb 실행을 재개하다. Restart = 다시 시작.

retrospective.note: A few strings mistranslate as 소급/회고록 — always 회고.

action.note: Existing strings use 작업, which collides with task = 작업 (e.g. Task actions became 작업 작업). Use 액션 for automation actions.

metric.note: Existing splits between 지표 and 메트릭; standardize on 지표 (matches 주요 지표).

assignee.note: One legacy string mistranslates as 양수인 (legal assignee) — always 담당자.

broadcast.note: Verb: 브로드캐스트하다. One legacy string mistranslates as 생방송 (live broadcast) — avoid.
